data.name: Fayiza
data.gender_notes: Fayiza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fayiza means 'giver of life'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'f-y-z', which means 'to live'. The name Fayiza carries the meaning “Giver of Life” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fayiza usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the gentle and delicate nature of a soul, often associated with the fragrance of flowers and the gentle touch of a mother's love
data.etymology: Fayiza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver of Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fayiza total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
